blocks.text: CEMS (musalsal emission napne ka nizam) factories ki jagahon par aam taur par CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs aur PM jaisi cheezon ko musalsal monitor karta hai.

Yeh ek jagah qaim (fixed) stations hain jin mein kai sensors aur analyzers lage hote hain jo real time mein (usi waqt) pollutants ki miqdar napte hain. Yeh shehri ilaqon aur industrial zones mein lagaye jate hain.
Sensors wale satellites door se bare ilaqon par atmosphere ke pollutants napte hain aur ilaqai (regional) aur aalmi (global) air quality ka qeemti data dete hain.

blocks.prompt: AQI ke liye data kahan se aur kaise jama hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Zameen par lage fixed monitoring stations (AQMS) aur factories ke CEMS real time mein PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃ aur VOCs napte hain, aur bare ilaqon ka data satellites ke sensors (remote sensing) dete hain. In concentrations ko AQI ke number aur us ke rang mein badla jata hai.

items: Factories par CEMS; shehron mein fixed AQMS stations; bare ilaqon par satellite remote sensing.
